findings.description: The instance user-data embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key in plaintext. User-data can be retrieved by processes with instance access and is commonly persisted in Terraform state and deployment history, allowing credential theft and reuse.

No metadata_options block requires IMDSv2 tokens, so the instance can permit IMDSv1 under the EC2 default. This leaves instance metadata more susceptible to SSRF-based credential or metadata theft if an instance role is added or metadata contains sensitive data.

The EBS volume does not set encrypted = true or a KMS key. Its protection therefore depends on an account-level default and can result in an unencrypted volume and exposed data if the volume or its backing storage is accessed.

This snapshot is created from aws_ebs_volume.web_host_storage, whose encryption is not enforced. EBS snapshots inherit source-volume encryption status, so this configuration can create an unencrypted copy of the volume's data.

TCP/22 is allowed from 0.0.0.0/0, allowing any Internet host to reach SSH on instances using this group. In conjunction with the public subnet and Internet route, this exposes the host to scanning, brute force, and exploitation attempts.
The egress rule permits all protocols and ports to 0.0.0.0/0. This does not constrain compromised workloads from reaching command-and-control infrastructure or exfiltrating data.

Instances launched in this subnet automatically receive public IPv4 addresses. The subnet is associated with a route table that has a default route through an Internet gateway, making workloads publicly reachable when their security groups permit it.

Instances launched in this subnet automatically receive public IPv4 addresses. Its associated route table has a default route through an Internet gateway, expanding the public attack surface of any future workload placed here.

The flow-log bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Storage encryption is therefore not declared or enforced by this configuration for network telemetry that can contain sensitive traffic metadata.
